summary: CHSP-TOOLS-1 iter237 batch verified end-to-end. Backend (6/6 new tests pass): POST /api/chsp1/service-entries creates entries with DD/MM/YYYY start_date; PATCH updates hourly_rate_or_fee (6->7.5) and start_date (01/01/2026->15/03/2026) and persistence verified via GET; POST /service-entries/{id}/expire flips is_active=false and drops from active list; POST /chsp1/letter (service_continuity + hardship) draft is retrievable via GET /api/lf1/correspondence/{id} with correct situation_id (6 / 9). Web /app/chsp/tools verified with cathy: Agreed Rate Schedule (chsp-agreed-rate-schedule) lists active saved rates (chsp-rate-{id}); Edit shows chsp-rate-edit-amount/date prefilled with 6 and 01/01/2026 (DD/MM/YYYY); Save persists new rate ($8.25) and new effective date (10/02/2026) in the list; Expire fires 'Rate expired' toast and removes the row from the active list. Both WS-5 defects flagged in iter236 are FIXED on web: (a) chsp-ws1-service-entry option now renders 'Domestic assistance · Acme Care (WT238)' via serviceTypeLabel (no raw enum); (b) selecting the saved entry pre-fills chsp-ws1-rate-date as '10/02/2026' (DD/MM/YYYY) and chsp-ws1-agreed-rate as '8.25'. Profile summary reads 'Status: On CHSP · started 01/01/2025' (DD/MM/YYYY). WS-1 service-type options capitalised: ['Domestic assistance','Personal care','Meals']. Mobile: not automated (SecureStore auth-injection remains blocked on Expo web preview, same env limitation as iter235/236); per request treated as code-review; parity for the same code paths already source-verified in iter236 and file diffs since then only touched the two WS-5 fixes.

issues: (Carry-over from iter236) React dev-only hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' on service-entry <select>, caused by dev instrumentation injecting <span> markers into options. Dev-only; no user-visible impact in production build.

integration_issues.issue: Carry-over from iter235/236: cannot inject kindred_token into SecureStore namespace on web preview, blocking UI automation. Not a shipped-code bug.

action_items: Optional: suppress the dev-only hydration warning on the WS-1 service-entry <select> by ensuring dev-instrumentation does not inject <span> children into <option> elements (cosmetic, dev-only).
Optional: consider deleting the WT238-family TEST entries seeded during testing (they are all now expired, so they do not affect UX).
critical_code_review_comments: PATCH /chsp1/service-entries/{id} correctly re-wraps rate + contribution into {amount, currency} sub-docs and preserves DD/MM/YYYY on start_date — no ISO leak.
Expire endpoint correctly pulls the entry_id from profile.active_service_entries and stamps end_date + status='expired' — clean history preservation.

AgreedRateSchedule.startEdit() prefills rate + effective date via formatDate(s.start_date) — handles both ISO and DD/MM/YYYY stored values (verified: BlueBerry entry stored ISO renders as 01/07/2025).
WS1FeeCheck.onServiceChange() now formats svc.start_date via formatDate before assigning to rate_effective_date — WS-5 defect from iter236 fixed.
Service-entry <option> now interpolates serviceTypeLabel(s.service_type) — WS-5 capitalisation defect from iter236 fixed.

success_rate.frontend: web 100% for tested flows; mobile UI automation blocked by env (source parity carried from iter236)
